The AMD Radeon™ RX 5500 XT graphics card takes 1080p gaming to the next level, delivering ultra-responsive, high-fidelity AAA gaming at up to 60 FPS and esports gaming at up to 90 FPS. The AMD Radeon™ RX 5500 XT is equipped with up to 4GB of GDDR6 high-speed memory and PCI® Express 4.0 support for maximum game performance, exceptional power efficiency and outstanding value.
